prompts.name: jensen_body1
prompts.prompt: Use the man in the reference photo (keep his face, grey hair, glasses and likeness recognizable), wearing his black leather jacket. Vertical 4:5 photorealistic cinematic editorial image. Keep the bottom 40% fairly dark and simple (space for text). No readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. Do not show any woman. Scene: late at night he sits alone at a desk in a dim office, head slightly bowed, typing on a laptop, the screen light on his serious remorseful face, green accent lights in the background.
